method: Latest hosted JSON durations in seconds, summed across completed attempts including retries. Multiple supplied reports of the same case are averaged. Timed-out attempts are conservative observed costs, not successful timings. Skipped, unexecuted and interrupted cases retain prior estimates/fallbacks. No local durations are used. S-tests step 2 (1710): moved rows keep their previous exact/fallback weights; merged rows sum their constituent weights conservatively. These migrated weights are not measured post-refactor durations. S-tests step 3 (2020): folded sonar, seabed, wall, catalog-approach and scan-still rows retain exact/fallback weights; each five-view wall sequence sums all five previous weights. Catalog approach guards now execute ordinarily. These are conservative migrated estimates, not measured savings.
